chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Hamdan al-Qushayri informed us. He said: Al-Mughira ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muhallab narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Ghaffar ibn Muhammad ibn Kathir al-Kilabi al-Kufi narrated to us from Amr ibn Thabit from Jabir from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn al-Husayn from his father (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

My love and the love of my Ahl al-Bayt is beneficial in seven places whose horrors are tremendous: at death, in the grave, at the Resurrection, at the Book, at the Judgment, at the Scale, and on the Path.

key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِي: Ahl al-Bayt (People of my House): the Prophet's family, understood in Shia Islam as the fourteen infallibles
key_terms.سَبْعَةِ مَوَاطِنَ: Seven places: the critical stations of the afterlife where divine judgment occurs

ai.seo_question: What are the seven places where love of the Prophet and Ahl al-Bayt benefits according to al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) declared that loving him and loving his Ahl al-Bayt (household) will benefit one in seven frightful stations of the hereafter: at the time of death, in the grave, at the Resurrection, at the giving of the book of deeds, at the Judgment, at the Scale, and on the Path (Sirat). This was transmitted through a Kufan chain reaching Imam al-Baqir from Imam Zayn al-Abidin from Imam al-Husayn.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. `Abdullah b. Sa`id narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Hamdan al-Qurayshi narrated to us. He said: Al-Mughira b. Muhammad b. al-Mahlab narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Ghaffar b. Muhammad b. Kathir al-Kilabi al-Kufi narrated to us from `Amr b. Thabit from Jabir from Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn from `Ali b. al-Husayn from his father (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

One who loves me and loves my Ahl al-Bayt will benefit in seven places and will be rewarded generously: (1) at death, (2) in the grave, (3) at the Resurrection, (4) at the [giving of the] book, (5) at the Judgment, (6) at the scale, and (7) on the Path.
